subject: general
question:
The bar chart given below shows the annual production (in 1000 tonnes) of coffee of a country for the years 2018 to 2022. What is the average production (in 1000 tonnes) of coffee for years 2018, 2019 and 2020?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2630778cb9f44455cec63a522e95e5f35f19d378bdf693a83c81ea41af80c61d.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average production of coffee for the years 2018, 2019 and 2020

⇒ (700 + 750 + 670)/3

⇒ 640

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
